title: Beyond Linear Approximations: A Novel Pruning Approach for Attention Matrix

contributions.purpose: 为 LLM 权重剪枝提出直接逼近(非线性)注意力矩阵的目标, 而非现有方法逼近线性函数 XW
contributions.mechanism: 把剪枝形式化为 Attention Weights Pruning 问题: 直接在融合注意力权重矩阵 W 上用单一剪枝掩码 M 逼近 Softmax(XWXᵀ), 以捕捉 Softmax 对大正值的 exp 敏感性(线性剪枝的 M_Q/M_K 无法捕捉)
contributions.evaluation: 定性/问题定义贡献, 号称首个研究注意力权重剪枝直接逼近注意力矩阵的工作; Figure 1/2 说明与线性剪枝的差异
contributions.domain: LLM 剪枝 / 模型压缩
contributions.source_quote: This is the first work that analyzes the weights pruning problem based on Softmax attention, which is a non-linear function.

contributions.purpose: 为这个高度非线性的剪枝优化问题提供可证明收敛的求解算法
contributions.mechanism: 推导剪枝损失梯度的闭式解(Theorem 5.3)与其 Lipschitz 常数(Theorem 5.4), 证明损失满足 PL 不等式, 给出基于梯度下降的 Algorithm 1 并证明收敛到近最优掩码(Theorem 4.1)
contributions.evaluation: 理论: Algorithm 1 在 O(d·poly(n)/ε) 时间收敛到近最优掩码, 误差 O(ξ+ε), ε 可任意小, ξ 由数据/权重内在性质决定(可通过取小 λ 减小, 但运行时间随之增大——存在 U 型 trade-off)
contributions.domain: LLM 剪枝 / 优化理论
contributions.source_quote: We provide Gradient Descent based Algorithm 1 to obtain the near-optimal pruning mask and its convergence guarantee (Theorem 4.1).

contributions.purpose: 实证非线性剪枝相对线性 SOTA(SparseGPT, Wanda)的优越性
contributions.mechanism: 合成实验(NumPy/JAX, d=64, 变 λ/n/ρ)测相对逼近误差; 真实 LLM(Llama 3.2-1B)实验; 端到端困惑度(PPL)实验, 剪枝率 0.5, C4 校准/评估
contributions.evaluation: 合成与真实实验中相对误差均大幅低于 Wanda/SparseGPT; PPL(Llama 3.2-1B, Dense MLP): OurAttn 13.885 vs SparseGPT 14.269 vs Wanda 14.912(Dense 基线 12.487); 组合 MLP 剪枝时仍一致占优
contributions.domain: LLM 剪枝 / 模型压缩
contributions.source_quote: We conduct experiments to verify the effectiveness of our method (Section 6), showing our non-linear pruning method is beyond SparseGPT and Wanda by a large margin.

self_declared_provenance.quote: We compare our method with two linear pruning approaches, namely Wanda (Sun et al., 2024) and SparseGPT (Frantar & Alistarh, 2023)... since the settings of SparseGPT and Wanda are linear, we do not prune the fused weight matrix W directly; instead, we prune W_Q and W_K separately.
As our method focuses on pruning the attention matrix, it can be seamlessly combined with approaches that perform linear pruning on the MLP, such as Wanda and SparseGPT.

notes: 定位为对 SparseGPT/Wanda 线性剪枝范式的替代(直接逼近非线性注意力矩阵)。以理论为主, 作者自述实证仅为'preliminary'(合成 + Llama 3.2-1B 小模型, 校准数据仅 8 句)。Trade-off/caveat: (1)误差项 ξ 与运行时间存在 U 型权衡(小 λ 降误差但增时间); (2)PPL 上剪枝后 OurAttn 13.885 仍明显高于 Dense 基线 12.487, 只是相对 SparseGPT/Wanda 更好, 属'降幅更小'而非无损; (3)剪枝率越大所有方法误差都上升。已被 ICLR 2025 接收。
